_comment: Auto-compaction policy, applied by install.sh and checked by bin/pi-setup-doctor.
Both read this file so the rule lives in one place.
Pi compacts when contextTokens > contextWindow - reserveTokens, but it only evaluates
that between turns. One agentic turn can be hundreds of entries long, so the reserve has
to cover an entire turn's growth, not just the next reply. Pi's default of 16384 assumes
the check runs often and is far too small for autonomous runs.
Measured on session 019fb8da (2026-07-31, gpt-5.6-sol, 272000-token window): the
threshold was crossed at 265232 tokens and the turn kept running for 64 more model calls,
peaking at 290536 - 18536 tokens past the window. It only survived because the provider
tolerated the overflow. reserveTokens 45000 would have compacted at 227000, leaving room
for the ~25000 tokens that turn added after crossing.
maxFractionOfWindow keeps the reserve away from bin/pi-setup-doctor's upper guard (half
the window) on small-context models, where a flat 45000 would leave too little usable
context. minReserveTokens is Pi's own default, the floor this never goes below.
